description: This file defines the AzureAISearchIndexProfileHandler class, which manages the validation and population of Azure AI search index profiles within the OrchardCore framework. It includes methods for initializing, updating, and validating index profiles, as well as internal logic for handling index metadata and query metadata.

classes.name: AzureAISearchIndexProfileHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing Azure AI search index profiles, including validation and data population.

methods.name: AzureAISearchIndexProfileHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the localizer for string resources.

methods.name: InitializingAsync
methods.description: Handles the initialization of the index profile asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdatingAsync
methods.description: Handles the updating of the index profile asynchronously.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Validates the index profile, ensuring proper naming and at least one index mapping.

methods.name: PopulateAsync
methods.description: Populates index and query metadata from JSON data, handling backward compatibility.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Checks if the handler can process the given index profile based on provider name.
